cases.purpose: Checks German month and weekday names, rejects English names, and verifies in-process LC_ALL changes to C and back. Numeric dates provide epoch controls. Missing locale or builtin is a setup failure.
cases.oracle: Fixed acceptance contract and numeric-date epoch controls in UTC.
cases.comparison: Exact success marker with empty stderr; any failed assertion or setup fails the case.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/mkdir loc || exit 97
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/localedef -i de_DE -f UTF-8 "$PWD/loc/de_DE.UTF-8" >le.out 2>&1 || { echo 'SETUP-INVALID localedef' >&2; exit 97; }
/usr/bin/cat > localized.sh <<'EOF'
export TZ=UTC0
[[ $(type -t strptime) == builtin ]] || { echo 'SETUP-INVALID strptime unavailable' >&2; exit 97; }
[[ $(printf '%(%B)T' 0) == Januar ]] || { echo 'SETUP-INVALID German LC_TIME' >&2; exit 97; }
fail=0
positive() {
  local input=$1 fmt=$2 numeric=$3 got expected
  got=$(strptime -f "$fmt" "$input" 2>/dev/null) || { printf 'FAIL localized: %s\n' "$input"; fail=1; return; }
  expected=$(strptime -f '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' "$numeric" 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'FAIL numeric control'; fail=1; return; }
  [[ $got == "$expected" ]] || { printf 'FAIL epoch: %s\n' "$input"; fail=1; }
}
negative() {
  if strptime -f "$2" "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'FAIL accepted: %s\n' "$1"; fail=1; fi
}
positive '15 März 2024' '%d %B %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
positive '03 Okt 2024' '%d %b %Y' '2024-10-03 00:00'
positive '1 Dezember 2023 13:45' '%d %B %Y %H:%M' '2023-12-01 13:45'
positive '15 märz 2024' '%d %B %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
positive 'Mai 7 2024' '%b %d %Y' '2024-05-07 00:00'
positive 'Freitag 15 März 2024' '%A %d %B %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
positive 'Fr 15 Mär 2024' '%a %d %b %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
positive 'Sonntag, 1. September 2024' '%A, %d. %B %Y' '2024-09-01 00:00'
negative '15 March 2024' '%d %B %Y'
negative '03 Oct 2024' '%d %b %Y'
negative 'Friday 15 März 2024' '%A %d %B %Y'
negative 'Fri 15 Mär 2024' '%a %d %b %Y'
export LC_ALL=C
[[ $(printf '%(%B)T' 0) == January ]] || { echo 'SETUP-INVALID C LC_TIME' >&2; exit 97; }
positive '15 March 2024' '%d %B %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
negative '15 März 2024' '%d %B %Y'
export LC_ALL=de_DE.UTF-8
positive '15 März 2024' '%d %B %Y' '2024-03-15 00:00'
negative '15 March 2024' '%d %B %Y'
(( fail == 0 )) || exit 1
printf 'localized checks passed\n'
EOF
LOCPATH=$PWD/loc LC_ALL=de_DE.UTF-8 "$BASH" --noprofile --norc localized.sh
